design_philosophy.core_concept: The Private Oracle. A highly confidential, sovereign, and premium voice-first single-page AI dashboard. It should feel like a private, intelligent chamber rather than a generic tech tool. Inspired by French Caribbean heritage (warmth, sovereignty, depth) intersecting with brutalist terminal typography.
anti_patterns_avoided: No generic chatbot UI (no chat bubbles, no input fields, no send buttons).
No Material Design shadows or generic cards.
No Inter or generic sans-serif fonts for main presence.

primary_heading_font.name: Cormorant Garamond
primary_heading_font.usage: Brand presence, FreKIDBadge, prominent numbers. Evokes sovereignty, exclusivity, and heritage.

secondary_body_font.name: IBM Plex Mono
secondary_body_font.usage: ConversationZone (streaming tokens), StateIndicator, StatusBar. Evokes terminal aesthetics, precision, and raw intelligence.

rules: Headings and badges MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large text, and extremely wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for uppercase labels.
Do not use generic sans-serif fonts anywhere.
Conversation stream text should be highly legible, using IBM Plex Mono at text-lg or text-xl, leading-relaxed.

background.description: Deep obsidian and abyssal blacks. Do not use pure #000000. Use the provided background image for cinematic grain.

states.idle: Muted, extremely low contrast. Grays and transparent teal.
states.listening: Caribbean Amber (#D97736) glow, signaling active attention.
states.thinking: Pulsing Thinking Bone (#E6E2D8), feeling like a high-compute process.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Single-page absolute/fixed layout. Zero scroll. The orb is the center of the universe. UI elements (badges, status) are pushed to the absolute edges (p-6 or p-8) to maximize negative space.

components.OrbeLaurentIA: Absolute center of screen. Large and commanding.
components.StateIndicator: Directly below the Orb, creating tension.
components.ConversationZone: Bottom half of the screen, above the mic button. max-w-2xl, centered.
components.MicButton: Absolute bottom-center, hovering with ample bottom padding (pb-12).

glassmorphism.usage: Used ONLY for FreKIDBadge and MicButton to separate them from the atmospheric background.
glassmorphism.classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-full

terminal_strip.classes: border-b border-white/10 bg-transparent text-white/50 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest px-4 py-2 flex gap-6

OrbeLaurentIA.idle: Slow, deep breathing scale (1.0 to 1.05) over 4 seconds. Opacity shifts between 30% and 50%. Layered blur-3xl divs.
OrbeLaurentIA.listening: Faster pulse. Scale pushes to 1.15. Color shifts aggressively to Caribbean Amber. Outer glow intensifies.
OrbeLaurentIA.thinking: Rapid, erratic micro-rotations and scale jumps. Color shifts to bright bone-white.
OrbeLaurentIA.implementation: Use framer-motion. Create 3-4 nested absolute divs with varying sizes and high blur (blur-3xl) to create a volumetric lighting effect.

ConversationZone.streaming_tokens: Tokens should appear smoothly. If possible, add a slight blur-to-focus animation on new tokens entering.
ConversationZone.fading: Older text should gracefully fade out using mask-image: linear-gradient.

images.description: Premium dark cinematic grain background. MUST be used as a full-screen absolute background behind everything with opacity-40 to opacity-60 over a base #0A0A0A background.

components_spec.name: OrbeLaurentIA
components_spec.instructions: Central visual anchor. Do not use an image. Build using nested motion.div elements from framer-motion with rounded-full, mix-blend-screen, and heavy blur (blur-3xl). Pass a 'state' prop ('idle', 'listening', 'thinking') to trigger different animation variants.

components_spec.name: StateIndicator
components_spec.instructions: Simple motion text. e.g., 'Laurent.ia écoute...'. Use IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], text-white/40.

components_spec.name: ConversationZone
components_spec.instructions: Container for SSE streaming text. Must handle text wrapping elegantly. Use IBM Plex Mono, text-lg, text-[#F3EFE7].

components_spec.name: FreKIDBadge
components_spec.instructions: Glassmorphic pill top-left. Shows user's first name. Font: Cormorant Garamond, italic, text-lg.

components_spec.name: StatusBar
components_spec.instructions: Minimalist terminal strip top-right. Shows 'v2.0-SOVEREIGN', 'Tokens: XX', 'JCC: XX'. Font: IBM Plex Mono.

components_spec.name: MicButton
components_spec.instructions: Massive tactile button. Bottom center. Toggle state between active/inactive. When active, glow Caribbean Amber. Must have data-testid='mic-toggle-button'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure streaming text (#F3EFE7) against dark background exceeds 4.5:1. Orb glowing should not obscure text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a single-page React app (hybrid_fullstack). Install 'framer-motion' for the Orb animations. Import the specified Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS. The entire application must fit within 100vh with overflow-hidden to prevent scrolling. Use the provided background image in an absolute full-size container with z-[-1] to give the UI a premium cinematic grain. Create mock states for the Orb (idle -> listening -> thinking) triggered by the MicButton for the MVP.
